text: Covariances psi theta estimated using LDL’ decomposition positive definite covariance matrix. decomposition expresses covariance matrix Σ\Sigma as𝚺=(𝑳+𝑰)diag(Softplus(𝒅uc))(𝑳+𝑰)′,\begin{equation}   \boldsymbol{\Sigma} = \left( \mathbf{L} + \mathbf{} \right) \mathrm{diag} \left( \mathrm{Softplus} \left( \mathbf{d}_{uc} \right) \right) \left( \mathbf{L} + \mathbf{} \right)^{\prime}, \end{equation} : - 𝑳\mathbf{L} strictly lower-triangular matrix free parameters (l_mat_strict), - 𝑰\mathbf{} identity matrix, - 𝒅uc\mathbf{d}_{uc} unconstrained vector, - Softplus(𝒅uc)=log⁡(1+exp(𝒅uc))\mathrm{Softplus} \left(\mathbf{d}_{uc} \right) = \log \left(1 + \exp \left( \mathbf{d}_{uc} \right) \right) ensures strictly positive diagonal entries. LDL() function extracts decomposition positive definite covariance matrix. returns: - d_uc: unconstrained diagonal parameters, equal InvSoftplus(d_vec), - d_vec: diagonal entries, equal Softplus(d_uc), - l_mat_strict: strictly lower-triangular factor.
code: sigma <- matrix(   data = c(1.0, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0),   nrow = 2,   ncol = 2 ) ldl_sigma <- LDL(sigma) d_uc <- ldl_sigma$d_uc l_mat_strict <- ldl_sigma$l_mat_strict I <- diag(2) sigma_reconstructed <- (l_mat_strict + I) %*% diag(log1p(exp(d_uc)), 2) %*% t(l_mat_strict + I) sigma_reconstructed #>      [,1] [,2] #> [1,]  1.0  0.5 #> [2,]  0.5  1.0
